label: early copy-phase echo of "c" in long sequences, before s/c/v
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the fed-back input is the letter c (100% of activations have in_tok = c). Almost all of it falls at recall_idx 1-3, meaning c was original token 0-2 and is now being echoed back. It is concentrated in long sequences (L 8-9, many outputs still to go, t 9-11). Even so, most such c steps stay silent: c-in-copy-phase with recall_idx <= 3 has recall and mass recall near 1.0 but precision only about 0.05. Magnitude and firing rate go up when the token output next is s, c or v (and to a lesser extent t, 3, d). The top activations are mostly c followed by s or c. Adding that output condition raises precision to about 0.44 but leaves out about 44% of the mass, mostly weak activations. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, on any other input token, on c late in the copy, or when L <= 4.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=c (+4.69), recall_idx=2 & in_tok=c (+4.08), phase=2 & in_tok=c (+3.56), in_tok=c (+2.69), orig5=w (+2.33), phase=2 & out_tok=c (+2.27). Lower it: orig2=o (-2.25), orig4=h (-2.16), to_go=1 (-2.11), orig5=j (-2.00).
